svg.aria-label: Four stages. Stage 1: C4 + E4, major third, 4 semitones. Stage 2: C4 + F4, perfect fourth, 5 semitones. Stage 3: B3 + F4, diminished fifth, 6 semitones. Stage 4: C4 + E4, major third, 4 semitones. Stages are steps in order, with no clock.
svg.title: A two-voice path in four stages

g.text: Stages are steps in order, with no clock. Colour bars name each stage's pair.
How to read this graphic: Read left to right, stage by stage. Each vertical coloured bar
joins the two notes of that stage and names its interval underneath; the lines show how
each voice travels between stages. Stages are steps in order, with no clock, so take as
long as you like at each.
